msdyn_channeldefinition.msdyn_description: Send push notifications that are also saved to the customer's in-app inbox.

msdyn_channelmessagepart.msdyn_description: Optional image from the asset library, shown with the message.
Alert + Inbox, Inbox only (silent), or Alert only (not saved to the inbox).
Optional. A newer message with the same key replaces the earlier one.
Main message text. The notification may shorten it; the inbox shows it in full.
Days the message stays in the inbox (max 180). Leave empty for the channel default.
Headline on the notification and the inbox subject. Up to 65 characters.
Where the customer goes on tap: a web page or a screen in the app.
